I added a welcome message for the group:

Forum to ask questions relating to the dynr packages in R, as well as discuss IRT analysis more generally. Bug reports or feature requests should be reported on the respective development versions of the packages on bitbucket (dynr-issues). 

Anyone can see this message when one access this group.
